description: This file defines a PHP class Jjwg_AreasViewArea_Detail_Map that extends a SugarView class and renders an HTML page containing a Google Map with polygon overlays for displaying geographical areas in the context of SuiteCRM. It includes methods for initializing and displaying the map with configured coordinates and styling.

classes.name: Jjwg_AreasViewArea_Detail_Map
classes.description: A view class responsible for rendering a Google Map displaying geographical polygons related to areas within SuiteCRM. It extends the SugarView class and outputs an HTML page with embedded JavaScript for map initialization and rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that calls the parent SugarView constructor to initialize the view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs HTML and JavaScript code to render a Google Map with polygons based on configuration and polygon points stored in PHP globals.
